content: The pre-trained multi-BERT is the official released one. This multi-lingual version of BERT were pre-trained on corpus in 104 languages. Data in different languages were simply mixed in batches while pre-training, without additional effort to align between languages. When fine-tuning, we simply adopted the official training script of BERT, with default hyperparameters, to fine-tune each model until training loss converged.
